commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Stuttgart work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+6' A quickly taken corner by Stuttgart.

90+5' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Alexander Nubel didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
90+3' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) takes the corner.
90+3' Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Florian Badstubner has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart).
86' The substitution is prepared. Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Angelo Stiller.
86' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Bilal El Khannouss.
82' 2:7 – this is the current number of shots on target.

80' 0 - 3 Goal Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart)! Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) was put through by Bilal El Khannouss and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
78' Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Maximilian Mittelstadt will be replaced by Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart).
78' Tiago Tomas is being substituted because of an injury. Sebastian Hoeness sends Badredine Bouanani (VfB Stuttgart) on the pitch.
77' Christian Eriksen comes off the pitch to be replaced by Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg).
76' The linesman makes the right call and Wolfsburg will have a corner.
75' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
73' The attendance for today's match is 26145.
70' A player from Stuttgart commits a rough challenge. Florian Badstubner blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
69' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Lovro Majer.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) comes onto the pitch so that Nikolas Nartey can be given a rest.
67' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Sael Kumbedi.
67' It is time for a substitution. Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) is on for Joakim Maehle.
67' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) but poses no threat.
65' The Stuttgart players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
64' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
62' The game is interrupted now, Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
62' Stuttgart are ruled offside.

60' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
57' Neat passing move from Stuttgart in order to create new attacking opportunities.
55' 0 - 2 Goal! Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 0:2.
53' Wolfsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

50' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
49' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
42' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) commits a rough foul. Florian Badstubner stops the game and makes a call.
40' The Stuttgart players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up. The ratio of the ball possession is 30:70.
38' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
37' Stuttgart take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
35' 0 - 1 Goal! Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Angelo Stiller and easily beat the keeper with a header into the middle of the goal from close range. 0:1.
35' Stuttgart quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
33' A pass by Aaron Zehnter (Wolfsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

28' This was a piece of cake for Alexander Nubel. Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.

27' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the right post. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
26' The corner is swung in but Stuttgart can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
26' There's an opportunity for Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
26' Stuttgart take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
24' The total number of attempts is 1:2.
20' Florian Badstubner shows a yellow card to Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) for his blatant foul.

20' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Florian Badstubner with no other option than to blow for a foul.
16' Great teamplay by Stuttgart as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

13' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
10' Stuttgart seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
6' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) has tested the patience of referee Florian Badstubner and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
4' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

4' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the left side of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! Stuttgart force their opponents to concede a corner.
